instruction.text: Beantworte die Frage, indem du auf das richtige Bild tippst.

atoms.a: Which way of getting to school is better for the environment?

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to pollute</voice> bedeutet verschmutzen und <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>pollution</voice> bedeutet Umweltverschmutzung <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to cause</voice> bedeutet verursachen

atoms.a: Why is it better for the environment to go to school by bus?
b: Buses are smaller than cars. Therefore, they cause less pollution.
++Many pupils can go by the same bus. Therefore, taking the same bus causes less pollution than going by car.

atoms.a: Why is the lunch on the right better for the environment?
b: ++The lunch box causes less waste because it can be used multiple times.
The lunch box causes less waste because it's more expensive.

instruction.text: Beantworte die Frage, indem du auf das richtige Bild tippst.

atoms.a: Which behaviour is better for the environment?
Why is he protecting the environment better than the woman is?
b: ++Because he is throwing his rubbish into the bin.
Because he is throwing his rubbish on the ground.

instruction.text: Fülle die Lücken des Dialogs über Umweltschutz in der Schule.

atoms.a: Ich fahre jeden Tag mit dem Fahrrad zur Schule. Wenn meine Freunde oder ich Müll sehen, werfen wir ihn in den Müll.
atoms.b: I go to school ((++by_bike_every_day by_car_every_day)). When my friends and I see rubbish, ((++we_put_it_in_the_bin we_leave_it_on_the_ground)).

atoms.a: Wenn ich in der Schule etwas schreiben muss, schreibe ich auf beide Seiten meines recycleten Papiers. Nach der Stunde schalten wir immer das Licht aus und schließen die Fenster. Wir schalten vor dem Wochenende auch die Heizung aus.
atoms.b: When I have to write something in school, I ((++write_on_both_sides write_on_one_side)) of my recycled paper. After the lesson we always ((++turn_off_the_lights leave_on_the_lights)) and close the windows. We also turn off ((++the_heating the_music)) before the weekend.

atoms.a: Nach der vierten Stunde esse ich Mittag in der Cafeteria. Oft esse ich vegetarisch, um die Umwelt zu schützen. Wenn ich mein eigenes Mittagessen mitbringe, habe ich es in meiner Brotdose ohne Plastik.
atoms.b: After the 4th lesson I eat lunch in the cafeteria. Often I ((++eat_vegetarian eat_meat)) to protect the environment. When I bring my own lunch, I have it in my ((++reuasable disposable)) lunch box.
